headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by strong AI‑driven sales.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit top‑line growth, with TCS posting 15.4% YoY revenue rise and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech highlighted AI revenue jumps of 78% YoY and delivered 3% QoQ revenue growth. Mid‑tier firms such as LTM and Tech Mahindra also posted healthy revenue gains, while profit growth was mixed, with Wipro seeing a slight dip in net profit.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue surged across several firms, notably HCLTech (+78% YoY) and LTM (+47% YoY), driving higher deal wins and margin expansion.

themes.title: Margin pressure at lower‑tier firms
themes.detail: Companies without strong AI exposure reported modest or declining margins, reflecting cost pressures and slower profit growth.
